caption: The drawing depicts five separate jewelry pieces arranged horizontally in the center of a plain, light beige background. The objects are colored in shades of red and outlined in black, with small touches of yellow that suggest metal settings. At the center, there is a large, oval red gem surrounded by ten smaller round red gems, with two additional clusters of three round red gems each, hanging below and adorned with three small, elongated red drops. Below the central oval gem, there is a single larger, teardrop-shaped red gemstone hanging. On each side of the central cluster, there is one long, smooth, teardrop-shaped red gemstone hanging from a small round red gem, which is topped with a small yellow circle. The arrangement is symmetrical and all objects are distinct, with ample space around them against the unadorned background.
title: Earrings and Pendant
